question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution:
The correct answer is '**However**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage discusses the shift in children's entertainment from storybooks to digital media.
 
• The word "However" is used to introduce a contrast, which fits well as the sentence contrasts the past with the present.
 
• "**However**" fits well as it indicates a change or difference in the scenario being described.
 
• Other options ("**While**", "**Though**", "**In spite**") do not fit the context of contrasting past and present habits as clearly.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

Complete Passage: *There was a time when storybooks were the only (1) ______ of entertainment for children. A decade or two ago, kids (2) ______ their time reading stories and role playing (3) ______ favourite characters from the stories. **However*__*, times have changed now – in the age of the internet, kids spend (5) ______ of their time playing games on smartphones or watching cartoons or videos on YouTube.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• While (हालाँकि): "While" suggests two things happening simultaneously, which doesn't fit the context of contrasting the past and present habits.
 
• Though (यद्यपि): "Though" can introduce a contrast, but it's usually used where a follow-up clause negates or downplays the previous fact.
 
• In spite (इसके बावजूद): "In spite" is used for contrast but indicates overcoming an obstacle, which doesn't fit the context as clearly here.
